lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu3Mg12Sn9 (reduced formula LuMg4Sn3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Lu centers have 12 geometric neighbors (6 Mg, 6 Sn), Mg centers have 12 neighbors (6 Lu, 6 Sn), and two Sn environments have 12 neighbors (9 Mg, 3 Sn). Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Sn 12-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
